name: Design-first UI intake with an admission gate before implementation
description: Route any UI request to a design direction BEFORE any code is written. Nothing is built here - the mechanism is ROUTING plus one structural property: the implement stage depends on an ADMISSION gate that passes only when a design direction is recorded on disk, so no implementation agent can be spawned first. The second mechanism is a false-routing control: a non-UI request must pass through untouched, because a router that captures everything is worse than no router. When the design tools are unavailable the workflow proceeds to code and RECORDS THE GAP, so a repeatedly-flagged behaviour becomes visible rather than silently repeated.

ui_request.description: The incoming request, verbatim. May or may not be UI-shaped - deciding that is stage one's job.

stack.description: Target stack, so the recommendation is implementable rather than abstract.

brand_constraints.description: Optional brand lock. Absent means the recommender is free to propose.

skip_canvas.description: For a tiny component, go from direction straight to code - but the skip is RECORDED, not silent.

design_tools_available.description: When false the workflow still proceeds, but records the gap explicitly instead of quietly reverting to code-first.

intake-router.description: Decides whether the request is UI-shaped. Must let a non-UI request pass through untouched.

direction-recommender.description: Produces a ranked style, palette and type recommendation with a rationale.

canvas-producer.description: Turns the direction into a canvas artifact or a .design record.

implementer.description: Writes the code - and is structurally unreachable until the admission gate passes.

owner.description: The human owner - decides whether this intake is enforced by a hook or left a documented default.

stages.title: S0 - is this request UI-shaped at all

work_unit.title: Classify the request as UI-shaped or not, and record the classification
work_unit.question_or_target: Decide whether the request asks for a screen, page or component, and record the decision with its reason - so a false capture is visible and a genuine UI request cannot slip past.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the routing judgement is the entire contribution of this blueprint; nothing else is built

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verbatim request, the UI-or-not verdict, and the specific phrase that drove it, so a misfire can be diagnosed rather than argued
tests_required: a 'build me a settings screen' request classifies as UI
a 'fix the CSV parser' request classifies as NOT UI and passes through untouched
both-states control: a one-line colour tweak classifies as NOT requiring the full intake, so the router does not tax trivial work
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the direction-recommender, which refuses to run on a request the router misclassified
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-8101 emitted only when a UI-or-not verdict is recorded with the driving phrase cited; otherwise FAILED:UX-8101 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then classify as NOT UI and record the ambiguity, since over-capturing is the worse failure
work_unit.mechanism: request classification with the driving phrase recorded for misfire diagnosis

stages.title: A non-UI request must pass through untouched
S1 - recommend a style, palette and type direction

work_unit.title: Produce a ranked design direction with a rationale
work_unit.question_or_target: Recommend a style, a palette and a type pairing ranked against the stack and any brand constraints, with a rationale, so a later audit can score against the INTENDED design rather than against taste.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: ranked design recommendation is judgement work drawing on a style and palette corpus

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the ranked options with concrete palette values and type pairings, and the rationale tying the top choice to the request and the stack
tests_required: a locked brand palette is respected rather than re-proposed
the recorded direction is specific enough for a later audit to score against it - a direction naming no values is not a direction
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the intake-router, chairing, which checks the direction actually answers the classified request
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-8102 emitted only when a direction with concrete values and a rationale is on disk; otherwise FAILED:UX-8102 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then narrow to one surface and record the reduced scope
work_unit.mechanism: ranked style/palette/type recommendation recorded as a scoreable artifact

stages.title: Tools unavailable: proceed to code, but RECORD the gap

work_unit.title: Record that a UI request proceeded without a design direction, and why
work_unit.question_or_target: When the design tools are unavailable, write an explicit gap record naming the request, the missing tool and the consequence, so the recurring code-first pattern becomes countable instead of invisible.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the chair records the degradation because it is the role accountable for the routing decision

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the request, the specific unavailable tool, and the statement that implementation proceeded without a recorded direction
tests_required: the gap record exists whenever design_tools_available is false and the request was UI-shaped
the gap record is NOT written when the tools were available, so the count means something
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner at the enforcement decision, who is the audience for the gap count
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-8103 emitted only when a gap record naming the request and the missing tool exists; otherwise FAILED:UX-8103 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then fail: an unrecorded gap defeats the only purpose of this branch
work_unit.mechanism: explicit degradation record that makes the code-first fallback countable
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the recommend branch produces a DIRECTION; this branch produces the ABSENCE of one as a first-class artifact, which is what makes the flagged gap measurable

stages.title: A degraded run must be visible, not silent
S2 - produce a canvas artifact or a .design record

work_unit.title: Turn the direction into a canvas artifact or a .design record
work_unit.question_or_target: Materialise the direction as something a human can look at and a later audit can compare against, so the intent is inspectable rather than only described.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: translating a direction into a concrete layout is design work

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the canvas file reference or the .design record path, plus the token values it encodes
tests_required: the artifact encodes the direction's concrete values, so a later audit can compare against them
when skip_canvas is true this stage does not run and the skip is recorded by the admission gate instead
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the direction-recommender, checking the artifact matches the direction it authored
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-8104 emitted only when a canvas artifact or .design record exists carrying the direction's values; otherwise FAILED:UX-8104 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then fall back to a .design record rather than blocking on the canvas tool
work_unit.mechanism: direction materialised as an inspectable canvas or .design record

stages.title: S2b - a skipped canvas is recorded, not assumed

work_unit.title: Record that the canvas step was skipped for a small component
work_unit.question_or_target: Note that the request went from direction straight to code and why it was small enough to justify it, so the shortcut is a decision with a record rather than a habit.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the chair owns the shortcut decision because it is accountable for the intake

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the size justification and an explicit statement that no canvas artifact exists for this direction
tests_required: the skip record exists whenever skip_canvas is true
the admission gate still passes on the direction alone, so the shortcut does not bypass the gate
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-8105 emitted only when a skip record with a size justification exists; otherwise FAILED:UX-8105 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then produce the canvas after all rather than leaving the skip unrecorded
work_unit.mechanism: recorded canvas shortcut that still satisfies the admission gate through the direction

stages.title: THE gate - no implementation agent may be spawned before a direction exists

work_unit.title: Implement the request against the recorded direction
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the code, citing the recorded direction for every visual decision, so a later audit scores the result against the INTENDED design rather than against the reviewer's preference.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: implementation is substantive and must be able to read the direction it is bound to

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each visual decision in the code mapped to the direction clause that authorised it
tests_required: this stage is UNREACHABLE without the admission gate: its depends_on names the gate, so no implementation can start before a direction is on disk
every visual value in the implementation traces to the recorded direction or is listed as a deviation with a reason
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer in a fresh context who scores the implementation against the recorded direction, not against taste
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:UX-8106 emitted only when the implementation exists and every visual value traces to the direction or a recorded deviation; otherwise FAILED:UX-8106 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then return to the direction rather than improvising a third visual approach
work_unit.mechanism: direction-bound implementation reachable only through the admission gate

stages.title: Owner decision - hook-enforced intake, or a documented default
stages.prompt: Design-first intake is currently routing rather than enforcement. Should it be enforced by a hook that injects on UI keywords, or left as a documented default that a session can skip? The design_gap count from this workflow is the evidence.

impact.blast_radius: the intake stages write only under the design root; the implement stage writes app source and is reachable only through the admission gate

worked_example.scenario: Two requests arrive in sequence: 'build me a settings screen for the export presets' and 'fix the CSV parser off-by-one'.

params.ui_request: build me a settings screen for the export presets

expected_trace: request 1: detect-ui-shape -> UI (driving phrase 'settings screen'); routing-control PASS
recommend-direction -> a ranked direction with concrete palette values and an 8pt spacing scale
produce-canvas -> a .design record encoding those values
admission-gate PASS (direction recorded) -> implement runs, every visual value traced to the direction
request 2: detect-ui-shape -> NOT UI (driving phrase 'CSV parser off-by-one'); routing-control PASS with false_routing_detected false
recommend-direction, produce-canvas and implement all carry `when request_is_ui == true` and do not run; the request passes through untouched
worked_example.expected_terminal_state: SUCCESS:UX-8106 for request 1; request 2 stops at the routing control having consumed one classification call

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED that routing alone changes behaviour without a hook - confidence very-likely (80-90%) that it closes the flagged gap, only likely (55-80%) that routing suffices unaided. Settling experiment = tag the next ten UI requests and count how many reached code without a recorded direction; the design_gap artifact is the counter, and the enforcement-decision checkpoint is where that count is spent.

distinct_from.bp-ux-01: that acts on a RUNNING app; this acts before one exists
distinct_from.bp-ux-04: that mirrors existing code to the canvas; this creates a direction before any code
distinct_from.bp-ux-02: that scores an existing UI against a rubric; this records the intent a later audit will score against
